'''''Carex hispida''''' (common name, '''hispid sedge''') is a species of tussock-forming, grass-like [[Perennial plant|perennial]] plant in the family [[Cyperaceae]]. It is native to the Mediterranean.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Carex hispida Willd. ex Schkuhr - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/1124269|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=Carex hispida (Hispid Sedge) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/CYPR/Carex_hispida.php|access-date=2022-02-08|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>

== Description ==
''Carex hispida'' is a grass-like perennial plant, with stems growing from 45–100 cm in height. Basal sheaths are dark brown and fibrous. Leaves are 4–8 mm wide and shorter than the stems.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Carex hispida (Hispid Sedge) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/CYPR/Carex_hispida.php |access-date=2024-11-14 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref> It is a [[rhizomatous]] plant with multiple male and female spikes per stem. Female spikes are unusually long (4–12 cm), with very short beaks at the end of the spike.<ref>{{Cite web |date=November 14, 2024 |title=Area of Botany, Department of Biology, University of the Balearic Islands |url=https://herbarivirtual.uib.es/en/illes-balears/748/especie/carex-hispida-willd-}}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
''Carex hispida'' favours wet, marshy conditions, such as non-saline bogs, ditches and marshlands.<ref name=":0" />
